title: Founder Runtime Approval Application Authority Activation Boundary
objective: Define the governed approval application authority activation boundary before any live authority can be considered, while keeping activation, approval application, DB/runtime writes, execution, provider calls, project mutation, deploy, package, network, and spend blocked.
safetyRules: Do not enable approval application authority activation in P123.1.
Do not enable approval decision application, approval capture, approval persistence, or approve/reject decision recording in P123.1.
Do not enable DB writes, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, runtime writes, runtime execution, or execution unlock in P123.1.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, execute workers/tools, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P123.1.
Do not change Command Center source or dashboard tests in P123.1.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw JSON/log/policy dumps, raw private IDs, raw DB names, raw report paths in primary UX, fake runnable actions, or mutation controls.
Future P123 subphases must define narrow authority, validation, UX, rollback, and explicit operator evidence before any later phase can consider live behavior.
knownLimitations: P123.1 is contract/policy only and does not enable live authority.
P123.2 is metadata-only and does not enable live authority.
P123.3 is model-only and does not enable live authority.
P123.4 is dry-run preview only and does not enable live authority.
P123.5 is scoped Command Center display-only UX and does not enable live authority.

Approval application authority activation, authority grant, approval decision application, approval capture, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, execution unlock, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and provider spend remain blocked.
